subject: geom = "histogram" - problem when all data points < 0

messages.author: 3033a60610caec0b
messages.subject: geom = "histogram" - problem when all data points < 0
parts:
geom = "histogram" fails when all data is less than zero.

Example:

jj <- rnorm(100) - 20
qplot(x, NULL, data.frame(x = jj), geom = "histogram")

Error: position_stack requires non-overlapping x intervals


Counter example:
qplot(x * -1, NULL, data.frame(x = jj), geom = "histogram")

## works fine

Hadley, any chance you can post updated code?

Thanks,
Brandon

messages.author: 3033a60610caec0b
messages.subject: Re: geom = "histogram" - problem when all data points < 0
parts:
The problems lies here: (in position-collide.r)

data <- data[order(data$xmin), ]
intervals <- as.numeric(t(unique(data[c("xmin", "xmax")])))
intervals <- intervals[!is.na(intervals)] / max(intervals)
# the previous line reverses the sign if max(intervals) < 0, which is
the case
# when all values are < 0, this causes the logical on diff in the
following line to
# be TRUE

if (any(diff(intervals) < -1e-6)) {
stop(name, " requires non-overlapping x intervals", call. =
FALSE)

}
